_metadata: Email-drafting judge suite (email_drafting_v1, 5 scenarios). Each row asks the model to draft a professional email; scored by the LLM-as-judge against the reference using tasks/rubrics/email_drafting_v1.yaml. References are hand-written PLACEHOLDER golds (not validated by a Duke communications office) — pipeline validation, not authoritative. New questions go in a new version file.

question: Draft a professional email to Professor Lee requesting a 2-day extension on the CS 201 assignment due this Friday, because you were sick this week. Offer to provide documentation. Include a clear subject line.
reference:
Subject: Request for a 2-Day Extension on the CS 201 Assignment

Dear Professor Lee,

I hope you're doing well. I'm writing to ask whether I could have a two-day extension on the CS 201 assignment due this Friday. I was ill for much of this week and was unable to finish it on time. I'm happy to provide documentation if that would be helpful.

If an extension to Sunday is possible, I would be very grateful. Please let me know what works for you.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
Alex Rivera

question: Draft an email to the Duke OIT Service Desk reporting that you cannot connect to the eduroam Wi-Fi on your laptop. Include the troubleshooting you've already tried so they can help faster.
reference:
Subject: Unable to Connect to eduroam on My Laptop

Hello OIT Service Desk,

I'm having trouble connecting to eduroam on my laptop (a Windows 11 machine). It prompts for my NetID and password but then fails to connect. I've already tried forgetting the network and reconnecting, restarting the laptop, and confirming my NetID password works on other Duke sites.

Could you help me get connected, or let me know what else to try? I'm happy to bring the laptop to the desk if that's easier.

Thank you,
Alex Rivera (NetID: ar455)

question: Draft an email to your academic advisor, Dr. Park, requesting a short meeting to discuss adding a Machine Learning & AI minor. Suggest a couple of times.
reference:
Subject: Meeting Request — Adding the ML & AI Minor

Dear Dr. Park,

I hope you're well. I'm considering adding the Machine Learning & AI minor and would appreciate 15-20 minutes to talk through whether it fits my schedule and remaining requirements.

Would Tuesday afternoon or Thursday morning next week work for you? I'm glad to meet during your office hours or at another time that's convenient.

Thank you very much,
Alex Rivera

question: Draft a brief, polite email to your TA asking where to submit the final project and what file format is expected.
reference:
Subject: Final Project — Submission Location and Format

Hi,

Quick question about the final project: where should we submit it (Gradescope, Sakai, or somewhere else), and what file format do you expect (for example, a PDF, a .zip, or a repository link)?

Thanks so much for your help!

Best,
Alex

question: Draft a friendly email to your project teammate Sam proposing to move your weekly meeting from Tuesday at 3pm to Thursday at 3pm this week, and asking if that works.
reference:
Subject: Move This Week's Meeting to Thursday?

Hi Sam,

Would it be okay to move our meeting this week from Tuesday at 3pm to Thursday at 3pm? Something came up on Tuesday on my end. Thursday at the usual time works well for me, but let me know if that's tough for you and we'll find another slot.

Thanks!
Alex
